title: Cold

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Cold is a status effect applied at night, or while Sheltered and Freezing. It reduces health regeneration by 50% and stamina regeneration by 25%.
It is counteracted by standing near objects that produce the Fire effect (such as a Campfire or a working Smelter) or by gaining a resistance to frost: temporarily by consuming a Frost resistance mead or permanently by wearing warm clothes, such as the Wolf fur cape, Wolf armor chest or Lox cape.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Despite the Burning effect being "hot", it will not negate the Cold effect. This allows for the player to both be on fire and cold at the same time, especially when fighting Cultists.

full_text:
Cold

Effects: Health regen -50% | Stamina regen -25%

Introduction. Cold is a status effect applied at night, or while Sheltered and Freezing. It reduces health regeneration by 50% and stamina regeneration by 25%.
It is counteracted by standing near objects that produce the Fire effect (such as a Campfire or a working Smelter) or by gaining a resistance to frost: temporarily by consuming a Frost resistance mead or permanently by wearing warm clothes, such as the Wolf fur cape, Wolf armor chest or Lox cape.

Notes. • Despite the Burning effect being "hot", it will not negate the Cold effect. This allows for the player to both be on fire and cold at the same time, especially when fighting Cultists.
